note: Rio Grande NF (Divide RD) campground and picnic area beside fast-moving Rock Creek in a stand of mature aspen, in a narrow valley ~9,200 ft, close to Monte Vista: CO 15 south 2.4 mi, right 2.5 mi to a T, then left 10 mi on CR 28 (dirt after 3.1 mi and single-lane in places, but passable by passenger vehicle). FS says some sites are next to the creek, but no per-site map or legible imagery shows a pad at the waterline. No horses in campsites. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 10 sites (7 back-in, 3 pull-through), $10, vault toilets, no drinking water, first-come only. Added max spur 35 ft, year-round season (snow caveat), 14-night limit, senior-pass discount, no-trash note, fees checked 2026. Note rewritten: 'spurs 20-40 ft, RVs up to ~30-35 ft' replaced by the FS 35-ft maximum (in sites), field facts dropped.
flags: Current condition on the FS page: 'Water across roadway at campground' (page header still 'Site Open'; last updated September 14, 2026). Not a closure, but a driver should expect water on the road at the campground. The forest-wide October 22-23, 2026 flood alert says 'Various roads throughout the Forest are impassible'; County Rd 28 is not among the damaged roads listed on the conditions page, and the Divide RD road table (June 11, 2026) shows '28 Rock Creek | Open'.
Road wording (FS directions): 'NOTE: County Rd. 28 is dirt after 3.1 miles and single-lane in places.' No RV, trailer-length, 4WD or high-clearance advice on the page.
Phone missing: Divide Ranger District (719) 657-3321 (FS campground page contact; 13308 West US Hwy 160, Del Norte).

Waterfront (stored creekside) unresolved, no change: the FS says 'some sites located next to the creek' and 'The sound of the creek can be heard throughout the campground'. Rock Creek is a narrow (~3-5 m) stream running along the campground's south-east edge, but Esri imagery is shadowed and NAIP shows unbroken aspen/conifer canopy over the loop, so no pad can be placed against the bank. There is no recreation.gov per-site catalog (first-come only). The canopy rule leaves the FS statement as the only per-campground evidence.
Pin 37.46862,-106.33226 is ~45 m S of the FS coordinates (37.46901011,-106.3323194), in the campground beside the creek. OK.
